title: Six years with Lucky, constant fights, and credit as David Francis
summary: He stayed six years though he and Lucky argued weekly, and early records list him as David Francis.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, where did you go from there? How long did you stay with that band?
Well, I stayed with Lucky for six years.

Yeah. It was really a happy six years, although every week I was getting a notice from Lucky because we were always fighting -- I don't know why, I guess we loved each other, but at the time, I was young and I had a hot head because I had a chip on my shoulder from which I didn't know about until later on in life -- the reason why I was so touchy -- but the least little thing he said to me would rub me the wrong way, and we would get into an argument. But I think he loved me and I think I loved him, too, you know?
I'm sure you did -- I did have the feeling that he loved you, because we just played a tape here
of a recording made from the Savoy Ballroom, and of course the only name he mentioned was my dear friend, David Francis.
Yeah, that was before they started calling me Panama. Few people were calling me Panama then, I was still David Francis.
That's why a lot of the early recordings, a lot of people don't know that it's me playing drums because they have David Francis on the thing instead of Panama.
